attributes.action: Currently in law the deeds of the property override the WILL needs changing
attributes.additional_details: In uk law the deeds on the property overrides the WILL meaning if the property owner does not want anyone on the deeds to receive anything they currently have no choice unless said person revoked themselves. The owner of the property and assets should have this choice especially when they are deemed to have capacity and not be dictated by law who receives their livelihood they have worked toward if they do not wish to share this. Easier right to remove a person off the deeds or WILL is stronger.
attributes.background: Currently in Uk law a deeds to a property overrides a written WILL, meaning if the owner does not want someone on the deeds to have any assests when they die only that person can revoke themselves. Leaving them in a difficult situation on being pushed for this person to have what they don’t.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do. We are not sure which type of joint ownership of a property you are referring to, and what specific action you want government to take. Wills and deeds can already be changed in many situations, and we do not have enough information to know what situation you are referring to and what changes you wish to see.

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do.
